Can you please explain what each of the options are in the advanced settings?

Ray distance, Velocity Threshold.

comments.author: tarkin
comments.body_html:
idk remember exactly, but it’s simple.
ray distance is the distance to the target door, you can crank that up to a hundred to breach the doors telepathically.
velocity threshold is the required velocity of the player character to breach. you can set it to zero and youll breach a door just by breathing on it.
